blocks.text: Welcome to the Future of File-Based Static Content Management
Aero CMS eliminates database overhead, vulnerability surfaces, and complex infrastructure. All content is stored as clean JSON files on disk and compiled into pure static HTML/CSS.

blocks.title: Zero Database Runtime
blocks.text: Visitors load pure pre-rendered static files at maximum edge speed without hitting an API or database.
